He was born in [[Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]]. At a height of {{convert|6|ft|0|in|m|abbr=on}} tall, he played at the [[point guard]] position.[https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/c/colsose01.html Sean Colson profile] @ Basketball-Reference.com ==College career== Colson attended the [[University of Rhode Island]], the [[University of North Carolina at Charlotte]], and [[Hagerstown, Maryland|Hagerstown]] Junior College. ==Professional playing career== Colson split the [[2000–01 NBA season|2000–01 National Basketball Association season]] with the [[Atlanta Hawks]] and [[Houston Rockets]].
